subject: [PATCH 2/6] kernfs: don't copy times and link count into the inode on refresh

2026-11-18.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the kernfs inode refresh process by reducing unnecessary data copies and updates. It stops copying times, link count, and other attributes into the inode on refresh, except for mode, owner, and group. The link count is now only updated when a directory's inode is set up, and it's asserted that this operation cannot be raced with __kernfs_remove(). Additionally, getattr no longer relies on the inode's link count for directories being removed, instead reporting 0 to prevent potential issues.
